# SPDX matching templates

The license texts `scripts/remote_daemon_notices.py` approves on its own: a
module's license file is approved only when the whole file matches one of these
templates under the SPDX matching guidelines (case, whitespace and the marked
variable parts such as the copyright holder may differ; nothing may be added).
Only licenses on the app's crate allowlist
(`scripts/cmux-next/check_app_crate_licenses.py` `ALLOWED`) have a template
here. Any other text goes to a person.

Copied unchanged from SPDX License List 3.29.0 (2026-09-16),
`https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data/tree/main/template`:
